# zen-proxy

> A local, zero-dependency proxy that lets **any** coding agent use opencode's anonymous **free** Zen models — no accounts, no API keys. It speaks **two wire formats**: the OpenAI API (`/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/responses`, `/v1/models`) for Cline, Roo Code, Continue, Aider, mimo CLI and opencode forks, and the **Anthropic Messages API** (`/v1/messages`) so **Claude Code works as-is**, tools included.

## The problem this solves

opencode's Zen gateway serves its free `-free` models (`mimo-v2.5-free`, `big-pickle`, `ling-3.0-flash-fin-free`, `nemotron-*-free`, etc.) **only to requests that mimic the opencode client**.

- With the right UA plus the `x-opencode-session` **and** `x-opencode-session-id` headers, `POST https://opencode.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions` with `Authorization: Bearer public` returns HTTP 200.
- Without a session header the gateway returns **400 MissingSessionID**; with only one of the two session headers it returns **403 FreeTierError**.
- The legacy `https://opencode.ai/zen/v1` base still answers `/models` but rejects genuine agent traffic with **403 FreeTierError**. The served base is `https://opencode.ai/inference/v1`.
- Most agents force their own UA and never send a session header, so they cannot use the free tier directly.

zen-proxy solves this by injecting the correct `User-Agent` and a stable per-client `x-opencode-session` pair upstream, then re-exposing everything on `http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1` — as either a standard OpenAI API or a standard Anthropic Messages API.

## Key facts

- **Endpoints**: `POST /v1/chat/completions` (stream + non-stream), `POST /v1/responses`, `GET /v1/models`, `GET /health`, dashboard at `GET /`.
- **Auth**: anonymous via `Bearer public`; BYOK via `defaultZenKey` config or an `x-zen-key` / real bearer token.
- **Session**: opencode's free tier requires `x-opencode-session`. The proxy mints one per client (stable per source IP, or one shared id for local clients) when the caller doesn't send one; set `injectSession: false` to disable.
- **Quota**: the free tier is per-IP; the proxy forwards the real client IP (`x-real-ip`/`x-forwarded-for` when `trustForwarded` is on), but for local/loopback clients it omits `x-real-ip` so upstream counts your machine's real IP — matching opencode direct usage and avoiding a bogus shared `127.0.0.1` bucket. Do not abuse or rotate IPs.
- **Anthropic API**: `POST /v1/messages` (+ `/v1/messages/count_tokens`) are translated to the target model's endpoint family and back, streaming included, so Claude Code can point at it via `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787`. Because the free tier only accepts requests carrying opencode's own tools, the proxy attaches opencode's built-in tools alongside the caller's (only ones the caller has a counterpart for) and renames calls back — the caller's system prompt is never modified.
- **Model fallback**: reads the free-model list from `models.json`, which a GitHub Action keeps current from opencode's public catalog every 6 hours. Tries them in order on 429/5xx **and** on model-level 4xx (`Model is unavailable`, `FreeTierError`, geo-blocked or unsupported models), honors `retry-after`.
- **Claude Code**: the installer puts `zen-claude` on your PATH (`claude-zen` on Linux/macOS, `claude-zen.cmd`/`claude-zen.ps1` on Windows, along with a `zen-proxy` shim); run `zen-proxy` then `zen-claude`. It execs `claude --settings` (not exported env, which Claude Code's own `~/.claude/settings.json` overrides) and leaves your existing Claude Code config untouched.
- **Endpoint routing**: Zen serves each model on either `/v1/chat/completions` or `/v1/responses`. `responsesModels` lists the patterns (`*` allowed); the proxy translates requests, tool calls, reasoning and SSE streams in both directions, so any OpenAI-compatible client works either way.
- **Free-tier gate**: opencode serves free models only to genuine agent traffic. A request needs a valid session pair (`x-opencode-session` + `x-opencode-session-id`), `stream: true`, and a system message carrying opencode's own wording; anything else gets `403 FreeTierError: OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode`. Tool definitions and `user-agent` are irrelevant. That is not the model being broken: such models are shown as `agent-only`, never pruned, and the proxy learns their true health from real client traffic (`ok (live traffic)`). Agents that stream (Claude Code, Cline, Roo, Continue, Aider, mimo, opencode) work as-is; one-shot non-streaming calls fall back transparently and the reply carries `zen_served_by` / `x-zen-served-by`. No synthetic probe can verify a free model — a retired one is refused identically — so the proxy learns true health from real client traffic (`ok (live traffic)`). Which free models exist comes from opencode's public `/models` catalog, kept current in `models.json` by the model-sync Action every 6 hours; the proxy reads that file at startup and follows it unless your config pins its own list.
- **Rate limiting**: optional per-client limit on chat requests (`rateLimitMax`, `0` = off). `/health` and the dashboard are never throttled.
- **Model aliases**: `modelAliases` maps any name (e.g. `gpt-4o`) to a free model; reply model is rewritten back.
- **Config**: `zen-proxy.json` (hot-reloaded) or env vars: `PORT`, `HOST`, `ZEN_URL`, `ZEN_UA`, `INJECT_SESSION`, `AUTO_UA`, `UA_REFRESH_MS`, `PROBE_AUTH`, `RESPONSES_MODELS`, `RATE_LIMIT_MAX`, `DEFAULT_MODEL`, `FALLBACK_MODELS`, `MODEL_ALIASES`, `PROXY_KEY`, `ZEN_KEY`, `TRUST_FORWARDED`, `TIMEOUT_MS`, `CACHE_MS`, `AUTO_SYNC`, `AUTO_SYNC_MS`, `ZEN_PROXY_CONFIG`.
- **Auto model sync**: probes every upstream free model with a tiny completion (sending a session header, matching real traffic) and updates the config automatically. Only definitively-gone models (`not supported`, 404) are removed — temporary blocks (`403 FreeTierError`, geo, timeouts) keep the model configured so it recovers by itself. `probeAuth` picks the probe credentials (`auto` / `anonymous` / `key`). A GitHub Action keeps the shipped list in the repo current too.
- **Requirements**: Node.js >= 18. Zero npm dependencies.

## Install

```bash
# Linux / macOS
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/12errh/zen-proxy/main/install.sh | bash

# Windows (PowerShell)
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/12errh/zen-proxy/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

Or clone and run: `git clone https://github.com/12errh/zen-proxy.git && cd zen-proxy && node zen-proxy.mjs`

## Point any agent at it

```jsonc
{
  "provider": {
    "zen": {
      "baseURL": "http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1",
      "apiKey": "public",
      "models": { "space-bunny-free": {} }
    }
  }
}
```

Quick test:

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"space-bunny-free","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"say hi"}]}'
```
